about_the_game:
Labyris – A Story-Driven Psychological Horror and Exploration Game

Labyris is an atmospheric game that pushes the limits of a fragmented mind lost in the depths of unknown darkness. Experience a thrilling journey whether playing solo or in a cooperative mode supporting up to 4 players online. In this game, survival is not only about escaping physical dangers but also about confronting your inner fears.

Key Features:

  • A rich narrative with characters burdened by a haunting past

  • Multi-layered environments filled with mysterious dungeons, eerie rituals, and supernatural entities

  • Multiple endings that change according to your decisions

  • Challenging puzzles and environmental clues that immerse you in a dark, oppressive world

  • A psychological horror experience that blends tension with intricate storytelling

  • Developed with Unreal Engine 5, offering hyper-realistic visuals and immersive effects

Your eyes will adapt to the darkness—as clearly as the darkness sees you.
Jarduun awakens... and now it’s with you.

content_descriptors.notes: Labyris contains frequent scenes of psychological horror, disturbing imagery, occult rituals, depictions of blood, and intense fear-based interactions. While there is no sexual content or nudity, the game explores mature themes through a dark and oppressive atmosphere that may not be suitable for all audiences.

detailed_description:
Roadmap

This early version is a preview of what’s to come in the full version of Labyris. We are currently polishing the mechanics, expanding the story, and implementing feedback from players like you.

We are building Labyris openly with the community. Expect regular updates, development diaries, and optimizations as we move toward Early Access. Join our Discord to share feedback and suggestions.

Your opinion matters! If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please share them with us on the Steam forums or in our Discord.

Stay tuned — we’re just getting started!

name: Labyris

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly at 1080p on low/medium settings. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Stable 60+ FPS at 1080p with high settings. SSD recommended.

short_description: A story-driven psychological horror FPS set in a mystical labyrinth. Explore eerie halls, solve environmental puzzles, and survive nightmarish encounters—alone or in co-op for up to 4 players. Wishlist to follow development.
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, Estonian, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support
